raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "2-D cantilever design-domain proportions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.5 fixes the longest side at 1 mm, but Sec. 4.1 and Table 1 provide no textual aspect ratio or shorter-side length.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangular domain: length 1 mm, height 0.5 mm",
        "Rectangular domain: length 1 mm, height 1/3 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Clamped boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Table 1 contains an unavailable 'Boundary Conditions' panel. The word 'cantilever' indicates a clamp, but the text does not locate it or specify its constrained span.",
      "readings": [
        "Both displacement components fixed along the entire left end",
        "Both displacement components fixed along the entire right end",
        "Both displacement components fixed along the middle half of the left end"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Applied load location",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 does not describe the loaded point or boundary; Table 1's boundary-condition graphic is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Mid-height of the free end",
        "Lower corner of the free end",
        "Lower longitudinal edge, halfway from the clamp to the free end"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Applied force vector",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.5 supplies the force magnitude, but no text specifies the direction for Table 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse, vertically downward",
        "Axial, toward the clamped end",
        "At 45 degrees, downward and toward the clamped end"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial application of the 0.1 N force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The Table 1 graphic is unavailable. Sec. 3.2.2 describes boundary traction, while Sec. 4.5 mentions force-location points; neither specifies this example's loaded extent or distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "A single boundary-node force of 0.1 N",
        "Uniform traction over a centered segment spanning 10% of the loaded end, with resultant 0.1 N",
        "Uniform traction over the entire loaded end, with resultant 0.1 N"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design material near supports and loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 gives no passive-region prescription. Passive regions described for later examples do not establish whether Table 1 includes attachment pads.",
      "readings": [
        "Every cell is designable",
        "The cells adjoining the load are fixed solid",
        "A one-cell-wide support strip and the cells adjoining the load are fixed solid"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2.2 explicitly presents its elasticity equations for 3-D problems. Sec. 4.1 does not specify the reduction used for the 2-D example.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is supplied for the 2-D problem. The stated in-plane normalization does not resolve it.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness of 1 mm",
        "Uniform thickness of 0.1 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Table 1 structured-grid resolution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No 2-D element counts are given. Sec. 4.6 only supplies the general requirement of more than 6000 SIMP grid points, which does not determine a resolution.",
      "readings": [
        "For a 2:1 domain, 120 by 60 elements",
        "For a 2:1 domain, 160 by 80 elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 cites a SIMP implementation without specifying its element formulation or quadrature in the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2 by 2 Gauss integration",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3 by 3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP density-filter weighting kernel",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies a density filter of radius 1.5 element sizes, but does not define its weighting function.",
      "readings": [
        "Linearly decreasing weights: max(0, r minus distance)",
        "Equal weights for all cell centers within radius r"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 does not specify how the filter handles neighborhoods intersecting the exterior of the domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the neighborhood and renormalize using only cells inside the domain",
        "Treat exterior cells as zero density and retain the full-neighborhood normalization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter-radius units for rectangular cells",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4 says '1.5 times the mesh element size' without requiring square cells or defining element size when horizontal and vertical spacings differ.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius equals 1.5 times horizontal cell spacing",
        "Radius equals 1.5 times vertical cell spacing",
        "Radius equals 1.5 times the geometric mean of the two spacings"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Minimum admissible SIMP cell density",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 specifies cubic modulus interpolation, but Sec. 4.1 gives no minimum density for the structured-grid SIMP optimization. The sigmoid description concerns DMF-TONN.",
      "readings": [
        "Minimum density 0, with zero-stiffness cells handled explicitly",
        "Minimum density 0.001",
        "Minimum density 0.01"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field for the 2-D grid optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 supplies no initialization. The uniform initial density of 0.5 in Sec. 4.2 is stated for the separate 3-D example.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density 0.5",
        "Uniform density 1",
        "A perturbed field containing equal numbers of cells at densities 0.45 and 0.55"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP density-update rule and move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 names an external SIMP implementation but does not reproduce its density-update settings. The stated Adam settings apply to the neural networks.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criterion updates with maximum absolute density change 0.2 per iteration",
        "Optimality-criterion updates with maximum absolute density change 0.1 per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP stopping criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies only the cited code's 'default convergence criterion'. The numerical criterion and iteration cap are absent; Sec. 4.4's settings concern a different 3-D implementation.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum cell-density change falls below 0.01, without a fixed iteration cap",
        "Stop when maximum cell-density change falls below 0.001, with a 1000-iteration cap"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
